#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Demo script showing PropScan's license-based detection capabilities.
"""

import sys
import os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), 'src'))

from propscan.core import PropScan
from propscan.licenses import LicenseClassifier

def demo_license_classification():
    """Demonstrate license classification."""
    print("=== License Classification Demo ===\n")
    
    classifier = LicenseClassifier()
    
    test_licenses = [
        ("GPL-3.0", "FOSS"),
        ("MIT", "FOSS"), 
        ("BSD-3-Clause", "FOSS"),
        ("Apache-2.0", "FOSS"),
        ("Proprietary", "Proprietary"),
        ("Commercial", "Proprietary"),
        ("EULA", "Proprietary"),
        ("Custom License XYZ", "Unknown"),
        ("", "Unknown")
    ]
    
    print("License Classification Results:")
    print("-" * 50)
    for license_text, expected in test_licenses:
        result = classifier.classify_license(license_text)
        status = "✓" if result.value == expected.lower() else "✗"
        print(f"{status} {license_text:20} -> {result.value.upper():12} (expected: {expected})")

def demo_package_detection():
    """Demonstrate package detection."""
    print("\n=== Package Detection Demo ===\n")
    
    scanner = PropScan()
    
    test_packages = [
        {
            "name": "firefox",
            "display_name": "Firefox",
            "version": "89.0",
            "manager": "pacman",
            "licenses": ["MPL-2.0"]
        },
        {
            "name": "google-chrome", 
            "display_name": "Google Chrome",
            "version": "91.0",
            "manager": "pacman",
            "licenses": ["Proprietary"]
        },
        {
            "name": "bash",
            "display_name": "Bash Shell",
            "version": "5.2",
            "manager": "pacman", 
            "licenses": ["GPL-3.0-or-later"]
        },
        {
            "name": "discord",
            "display_name": "Discord",
            "version": "1.0",
            "manager": "flatpak",
            "licenses": ["unknown"]  # Will use fallback detection
        }
    ]
    
    print("Package Detection Results:")
    print("-" * 80)
    for package in test_packages:
        is_proprietary = scanner.detector.is_proprietary(package)
        reason = scanner.detector.get_detection_reason(package)
        status = "PROPRIETARY" if is_proprietary else "FOSS"
        licenses = ", ".join(package["licenses"])
        
        print(f"📦 {package['name']:15} | {licenses:15} | {status:12} | {reason}")

def demo_real_system_scan():
    """Demonstrate scanning real system packages."""
    print("\n=== Real System Scan Demo ===\n")
    
    scanner = PropScan()
    available_managers = scanner.get_available_managers()
    
    print(f"Available package managers: {[m.name for m in available_managers]}")
    
    if not available_managers:
        print("No package managers available for scanning.")
        return
    
    # Test with first available manager
    manager = available_managers[0]
    print(f"\nScanning with {manager.name}...")
    
    try:
        # Get just a few packages for demo
        packages = manager.get_installed_packages()[:3]
        
        print(f"Sample of {len(packages)} packages:")
        print("-" * 80)
        
        for package in packages:
            is_proprietary = scanner.detector.is_proprietary(package)
            status = "PROPRIETARY" if is_proprietary else "FOSS"
            licenses = ", ".join(package.get("licenses", ["unknown"]))
            
            print(f"📦 {package['name']:20} | {licenses:20} | {status}")
            
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error during scan: {e}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("PropScan License-Based Detection Demo")
    print("=" * 50)
    
    demo_license_classification()
    demo_package_detection()
    demo_real_system_scan()
    
    print("\n" + "=" * 50)
    print("Demo completed! PropScan now uses intelligent license detection")
    print("instead of hardcoded lists to identify proprietary software.")
